shortDescription: Used to make changes to the system wide Audit Policy

options.name: audit_type
options.description: The type of event you would like to audit for. Accepts a list. See examples.

options.name: category
options.description: Single string value for the category you would like to adjust the policy on. Cannot be used with I(subcategory). You must define one or the other. Changing this setting causes all subcategories to be adjusted to the defined I(audit_type).

options.name: subcategory
options.description: Single string value for the subcategory you would like to adjust the policy on. Cannot be used with I(category). You must define one or the other.
